name: Thermal Analysis & Thermophysical Testing
summary: Uses controlled heating and cooling to measure transitions, reactions, stability and thermal properties of materials.

topics.name: Principles of thermal analysis and instrument calibration
Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC): Tg, melting, crystallisation and cure
Differential thermal analysis (DTA) for high-temperature transitions
Thermogravimetric analysis (TGA): decomposition, oxidation and filler content
Dilatometry: thermal expansion and phase-transformation start temperatures
Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) and thermomechanical analysis (TMA)
Thermal conductivity and diffusivity: laser flash, hot disk and guarded hot plate
Kinetic analysis of thermal data (Kissinger, isoconversional methods)
Calorimetry for battery safety (accelerating rate calorimetry)
